issue_context.title: executor: indexMergeJoin, indexHashJoin and IndexJoin error
comments:
minor case to reproduce this problem:
``` sql
CREATE TABLE `t1` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ;
CREATE TABLE `t2` (
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int(11) DEFAULT NULL
);
insert into t1 values(1);
insert into t2 values(1,1), (2,1);

tidb> select /*+ hash_join(t1)*/ * from t1 join t2 on t2.b=t1.id and t2.a=t1.id;
+----+------+------+
| id | a    | b    |
+----+------+------+
|  1 |    1 |    1 |
+----+------+------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

tidb> select /*+ inl_join(t1)*/ * from t1 join t2 on t2.b=t1.id and t2.a=t1.id;
+----+------+------+
| id | a    | b    |
+----+------+------+
|  1 |    1 |    1 |
|  1 |    1 |    1 |
+----+------+------+
2 rows in set (0.01 sec)
```

review_comments: Can we assume that all keys here are the primary key column of the inner-table?
